K6 Telephone Box Red

The classic K6 kiosk, designed by Giles Gilbert Scott in 1935, is painted a specific red: BS 381C 539 ‘Post Office Red’. It’s a deep, warm red that stands out on any street.

Post Office Red

Firebrick
#B22222
Dark Red
#8B0000

The K6 was not the first red phone box; earlier K2 and K3 models were also red, but the K6 became the icon.
